meta.method: Handshakes for series 1-16 week 5 come from BuzzFeed's full list (Oct 2025), cross-checked against Wikipedia episode tables; series 16 weeks 6-10 and series 17 come from weekly recaps. Baker bios, air dates and Star Bakers come from Wikipedia. Timestamps and clip links were not reliably findable, so they are left blank; each row has a YouTube search link instead. confidence=high means two or more sources agree; medium means one list source plus a consistent episode table.
